subject: general
question: Who is properly known as the 'Grand Old Lady' of the Independence Movement?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aruna Asaf Ali**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Aruna Asaf Ali is popularly known as the 'Grand Old Lady' of the Indian Independence Movement due to her significant contribution to India's struggle for freedom.
 
• She is best remembered for hoisting the Indian National Congress flag at the Gowalia Tank Maidan, Bombay, during the Quit India Movement in 1942.
 
• Aruna Asaf Ali played a crucial role in organizing protests, strikes, and other activities against British rule, demonstrating her unwavering dedication to India's independence.
 
• She was awarded the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian award, in 1997 posthumously for her invaluable contributions to the nation.
 
• She was also the first elected Mayor of Delhi, representing her leadership and influence in post-independence India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Quit India Movement:**

 
 
• Launched by Mahatma Gandhi on 8 August 1942, demanding an end to British rule in India.
 
• It was a mass protest demanding "Do or Die" for independence.
 
• Aruna Asaf Ali's hoisting of the flag became a symbol of defiance against British rule.
 
 
 
• **Bharat Ratna:**
 
 
• India's highest civilian award, instituted in 1954.
 
• Awarded for exceptional service in the highest order in any field of human endeavor.
 
• Recipients include prominent figures such as C. Rajagopalachari, S. Radhakrishnan, and Jawaharlal Nehru.
 
 
 
• **Indian National Congress:**
 
 
• Founded in 1885, played a pivotal role in India's independence movement.
 
• Leaders like Mahatma Gandhi, Jawaharlal Nehru, and Sardar Patel were its prominent members.
 
• Organized major movements like Non-Cooperation, Civil Disobedience, and Quit India Movement.
 
 
 
• **Role of Women in Independence Movement:**
 
 
• Women leaders like Sarojini Naidu, Kasturba Gandhi, and Kamala Nehru played significant roles.
 
• They participated in protests, boycotts, and were also imprisoned.
 
• Their involvement showcased the inclusive nature of the independence struggle.
